Nicole Kidman AMC Ad
	

	
	
	

		

 

 

Nicole Kidman… Chloe Fineman

[Starts with Nicole Kidman walking. She opens her hoodie.]

Nicole Kidman narrating:
 We come to this place for magic. We come to AMC theaters to laugh, to cry, to care. Because we need that, all of us, that indescribable feeling we get when the lights begin to dim.

Nicole Kidman:
 Oh, I can’t describe it.

Nicole Kidman narrating:
 And we go places we’ve never been before.

Nicole Kidman:
 Not just entertained, but somehow reborn… [Kenan walks in the theater with a drink and popcorn. Nicole Kidman looks at Kenan.] Together. [Kenan is confused. So he moves away.]

Nicole Kidman narrating:
 Dazzling images on a huge silver screen. Somehow heartbreak feels good in a place like this.

All: 
Heartbreak feels good in a place like this. Heartbreak feels good in a place like this. Heartbreak feels good in a place like this.

Nicole Kidman narrating:
 With sound that I can feel.

 




 

Nicole Kidman:
 Our heroes feel like the best part of us. And our stories feel perfect. It’s powerful.

[Punkie is walking outside. She hears what’s going on inside]

Punkie: 
What the hell?

Nicole Kidman:
 Because we are here. AMC, we make movies better.

Kenan: 
What the [bleep] just happened?
